abstract: Synchron has paused clinical trials of its second-generation brain-computer interface. Leaders say the pause is not safety related.

Get your daily dose of health and medicine every weekday with STAT’s free newsletter Morning Rounds. Sign up here.

Buongiorno! Today’s stories have me wondering what it must be like to study the human brain: Every new discovery is a breathtaking revelation, and also a reminder of how little we know, and how far the horizon of full understanding still is. It feels a little like looking at the universe, only what is infinite is, in the most literal sense, ourselves.
